title: '$ROOT_PREFIX_FOR_IDE_RESOLUTION_MODE' cannot be used in source code. It's an implementation detail of IntelliJ IDEA's Kotlin language support. In most cases it can be removed without changing behavior. If you notice IntelliJ IDEA adding '$ROOT_PREFIX_FOR_IDE_RESOLUTION_MODE' to source code, please report an issue to https://kotl.in/plugin-issue.
